messages:
tess: FYI pushed a lightweight runtime tweak called 'hold-and-hint' into canary earlier. Early numbers look solid: p50 down ~12.3%, p99 down ~26%, token cost down ~9.4% on chat traces. No model changes, runtime-only. :sparkles:

launch-bot: canary->prod snapshot:
- p50: 84ms -> 73.8ms (-12.3%)
- p99: 430ms -> 318ms (-26.0%)
- avg token cost: $0.0093 -> $0.0084 (-9.7%)
- error rate: 0.016% -> 0.017% (within tolerances)

kai: awesome. what did we change exactly? microbatcher or prefetch?

tess: brief: microbatcher adds an adaptive micro-hold (up to 10ms) when a prefix-prob hint from the proxy arrives; the proxy also returns a tiny in-line hint for hot-prefixes so the runtime can skip a remote KV hop. Both are model-agnostic. Tuned conservative timeboxes to avoid p99 regressions.

sre: rollback & opt-out details? need runbook/flags for tenants and pool owners.

tess: flag `runtime.hold_and_hint` (per-pool). Rollback: `POST /release/flags/runtime.hold_and_hint/disable` body '{"pool":"<pool>"}'. Tenant opt-out via `runtime.disable_hold_and_hint=true`. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/hold-and-hint (internal).

marta: quick canary check command so pool owners can validate:
```
# p99 delta per pool between canary and prod snapshot
python infra/compare_metrics.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-99 --to prod --group pool
```

telemetry-bot: graphs: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashboards/hold-and-hint (internal)

kai: please craft a one-line blurb for ops & CS with the opt-out link. I'll add alarms for the next hour.

tess: Draft blurb: "Deployed hold-and-hint (canary->prod): p50 -12%, p99 -26%, token cost -9.7%. Opt-out: runtime.disable_hold_and_hint=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/hold-and-hint" :white_check_mark:

launch-bot: feature `runtime.hold_and_hint` enabled on canary pools: gpu-us-west-1a, gpu-eu-west-1b. Rolling to additional pools in 30m if green.

tess: thanks all  huge props to proxy+microbatch teams. will post a short follow-up with histograms and cost breakdowns later today. :party_parrot:
